Class Shell

java.lang.Object
Shell
public class Shell extends Object
A simple shell that mimics some basic features of bash. Java has no real fork/exec, so each command runs as a separate forked java process (see ProcessBuilder) that locates and loads the real command class at runtime via a URLClassLoader and reflection — shell has no compile-time dependency on commandBin. See README.md for the full picture; executeCommand(java.lang.String) is where it comes together.

      public static String classNameToCommandName(String className)
      Converts a PascalCase class name to kebab-case (e.g. "WordCount" to "word-count"), splitting on lower-to-upper boundaries via lookaround regex so acronym runs stay together.
